full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J : This petition for leave to appeal by the plaintiff-petitioner is from the judgment and order dated 6-6-95 passed by a learned Single Judge of the High Court. Division in civil revision No. 424 of 1991 setting aside the judgment and decree passed on 29-8-90 in S. C. C. Suit No. 1 of 1982 by the learned Assistant Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka. 

 4. The trial Court decreed the suit on the finding that the registered lease deed establishes the landlord-tenant relation-ship and therefore the defendant is liable to be evicted. 

 5. The High Court Division reversed the decree of the trial Court on the ground that a serious question of title is involved in respect go the suit property and a suit for eviction does not lie in the S. C. C. file. The plaintiff has not given any indication in the plaint or evidence as to how he became the owner of the suit land. On his own admission the defendant did not pay him any rent since the creation of the lease in 1952. The defendant has produced an unregistered document Ext. A which is a permission given by Manu Mia for the collateral purpose of deciding how he entered into the possession of the suit land. The trial Court did not consider this document in its true perspective and also did not consider the evidence adduced by the defendant.
